visual_identity.core_identity: Natural cave bats with unmistakable membrane wings supported by elongated finger bones, pointed ears, compact mammal bodies, and clawed roosting feet.
visual_identity.silhouette: Compact torso, broad membrane wings, large ears, clawed hind feet; swarm variants repeat the same anatomy at smaller scale.
visual_identity.head_features: Natural bat face with short muzzle and prominent ears, never humanoid or draconic.
visual_identity.body_shape: Light flying mammal body with wings formed by elongated fingers and thin membranes.
visual_identity.surface: Short restrained body fur and smooth wing membranes with minimal vein detail.
